title: Unexpected Reinforcements
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji gripped the warm Jade Slip tightly, the aged voice from the depths of the Tianji Record sounded again—this time, not a fragment of his father's consciousness, but a name he never expected.

text.content: The voice from the depths of the Tianji Record struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. 'Find the fourth page...' His father's dying words still echoed in his ears, yet the situation he faced now was more brutal than any prophecy. Behind him, three fierce sword lights pierced through the air—the Holy Sect pursuers' unique sword qi, carrying a bizarre aura that corroded everything. Ahead was a bottomless abyss, to the left a primeval forest dense with prohibitions, to the right a lifeless cemetery of graves. There was no escape.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, you cannot escape.' A cold voice descended from the heavens, carrying undeniable pressure. 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao has already marked your position. No matter where you flee, you cannot escape this chessboard. Hand over the Tianji Record obediently, and perhaps you may keep your corpse intact.'

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curled into a cold smile, but his mind raced with calculations. Three pursuers at the Golden Core stage, one suspected Yuan Ying stage observer in the shadows, plus his own exhausted Heavenly Fate value—this situation was almost a deadlock. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea pulsed with warmth, as if responding to his father's final words. He took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions, his gaze growing increasingly calm. The more desperate the situation, the calmer one must be. This was his survival principle from years of navigating the martial world.

dialogue.content: At this moment, a cold female voice came from the side: 'Chen Ji!' Chen Ji's heart shook. He turned to see Su Qingyao traversing through the forest, her white robes stained with blood, yet still maintaining that cold and noble aura. In her hand was a shattered communication Jade Talisman, clearly tracking him through some secret method. 'Why are you here?' Chen Ji frowned. 'It's too dangerous here. You shouldn't have come!'

text.content: Su Qingyao landed beside him, a complex light flickering in her eyes: 'I am the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. When sect disciples are in danger, I must intervene.' She paused, her voice dropping slightly, 'Besides... you are a member of the Tianqing Sect.' The words sounded stiff, but Chen Ji detected a different meaning within them. His heart warmed slightly, but there was no time for contemplation. The sword qi behind them was already approaching within a hundred zhang, the air filled with a nauseating smell of blood.

dialogue.content: 'Stop逞强.' Chen Ji grabbed Su Qingyao's wrist, his gaze sweeping across the surroundings as he quickly analyzed the situation. 'Three pursuers, the leader at least mid-Golden Core stage, with a powerful expert backing them up. Fighting head-on is a dead end.' Before he finished speaking, a sword qi had already shattered the boulder beside them, sending debris flying. Su Qingyao's expression shifted slightly, yet she remained stubbornly in place.

text.content: Chen Ji sensed the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrating intensely, as if sensing something. Instinctively, he looked up to see a figure appear out of nowhere at the cliff's edge, as if stepping out of the Void. The newcomer wore cyan robes, their features obscured by a thin mist, the specific appearance indiscernible. However, the aura emanating from them made Chen Ji's pupils contract—it was an energy from the same source as the Tianji Record, as if from the same ancient lineage.

dialogue.content: 'Who are you, honored senior?' Chen Ji asked in a deep voice, his body instinctively positioning itself in front of Su Qingyao. The newcomer did not answer directly, merely waving a hand. A mysterious rune burst open in the air, instantly covering a hundred zhang in all directions. The pursuers' sword qi collided with the rune barrier, producing a deafening roar, yet could advance no further. Having done this, the newcomer turned around and looked at Chen Ji for the first time. Those eyes obscured by mist seemed to contain endless vicissitudes and stories.

text.content: Alarm bells rang in Chen Ji's heart. This person's arrival was far too suspicious, the timing too precise, as if they had known long beforehand that they would fall into this desperate situation here. The resonance from the Tianji Record Fragment grew increasingly intense—a kind of long-lost... intimacy? No, it was familiarity! This sense of familiarity made Chen Ji's back grow cold, yet he could not resist the desire to draw closer. He recalled his father's words before death: 'Find the fourth page, that is the key to breaking the局.' Could this person be related to the fourth page?

choice.prompt: A mysterious helper suddenly appeared, releasing an energy from the same source as the Tianji Record. Chen Ji needed to judge whether this was a blessing or a curse.

choices.text: Take the initiative to probe and express willingness to cooperate
choices.description: Since the other party offered help, we might as well放下 our guard and probe their true intentions.
choices.risk_hint: The other party's motives are unclear, they may have deeper purposes

dialogue.content: 'I am deeply grateful for the senior's rescue.' Chen Ji clasped his fists in salute, his tone neither servile nor overbearing. 'May I ask what connection the senior has with the Tianji Record? Why help me?'

text.content: The newcomer fell silent for a moment, those mist-obscured eyes seemingly examining Chen Ji, as if confirming something. After a moment, he spoke, his voice aged and distant: 'You carry Chen Xuan's aura.' Chen Ji's heart shook violently. His father's name spoken by a stranger brought far greater impact than imagined. Su Qingyao sensed Chen Ji's unusual reaction, her hand secretly gripping her sword hilt, vigilantly staring at the newcomer.

choices.text: Maintain distance and demand the other party's identity
choices.description: In desperate situations, reinforcements that appear out of nowhere are often the most suspicious. One must first clarify the other party's background.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for assistance
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself and not reveal one's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: The other party may grow impatient and leave

dialogue.content: 'I appreciate the senior's kindness.' Chen Ji took a step back, maintaining a safe distance from the newcomer. 'But one should not accept favors without reason. The senior and I are strangers. Why risk such danger to save me?'

text.content: The visitor did not seem surprised by Chen Ji's reaction; instead, he gave a meaningful smile. "You are cautious, that's good." He raised his hand and pointed at Chen Ji's brow center. "If the heir of the Tianji Record wasn't cautious enough, he would have died without a burial place long ago. Rest assured, I am not your enemy. As for why I saved you..." He paused, "Because your father once saved me."

"Father... saved you?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly; this news was too shocking. When his father Chen Xuan was alive, he never mentioned having such a friend or benefactor. And now this mysterious figure suddenly appeared at his most dangerous moment, also mentioning the fourth page—was all this coincidence, or a chess game long predestined? The Tianji Record Fragment trembled again, as if responding to some ancient summoning. Chen Ji instinctively pressed his hand to his brow center, trying to extract more information from the fragment, but only felt chaos.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao listened nearby, her brow furrowed. Though she didn't know the specific secrets of the Tianji Record, from their conversation she had already sensed that this mysterious figure and Chen Ji shared some profound connection. "Chen Ji, is he friend or foe?" she asked quietly, her voice only audible to the two of them. Chen Ji was silent for a moment, quickly weighing matters in his heart. Though the person's motives were unclear, he had indeed saved them at a critical moment. And that aura of the same source as the Tianji Record made it impossible for him to completely dismiss the other party's sincerity.

text.content: The mysterious man seemed to see through Chen Ji's hesitation and didn't press him. Instead, he drew a complex route in the air with his hand. "The Holy Sect's pursuers are just an appetizer," his voice was calm yet carried undeniable authority, "the real danger is the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Principles. Go east along this path for three hundred li; there's the entrance to an ancient ruin. There remain formation arrays laid down by Chen Xuan back then, which can temporarily shield the Tianji Record's aura." With that, he took out a warm jade slip from his sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: The mysterious person handed over the jade slip, hinting that crucial information was concealed within. Chen Ji needed to decide whether to accept it.

choices.text: Accept the jade slip, then inquire about its contents.
choices.description: Since the other party has already shown sincerity, it's best to accept first and then ask for details.
choices.risk_hint: May fall into the other party's scheme.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji reached out his hand and took the jade slip. The moment it touched his palm, a warm current radiated from within, as if carrying some ancient memory. He pressed the jade slip against his brow center and sensed a blurry image sealed inside—a ruin shrouded in mist, with an ancient stone door faintly visible deep within, covered in characters similar to those of the Tianji Record.

"This jade slip contains..." Chen Ji was about to ask when the mysterious man raised his hand to interrupt him. "The contents inside, you will naturally understand when you reach the ruin. There's no time to explain now." He looked up at the sky, his brow slightly furrowed, "The gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Principles is intensifying; the time I've bought for you won't last long. Go now!" Before his words finished, the distant horizon suddenly darkened, and a suffocating pressure came surging from all directions.

choices.text: Refuse the jade slip and demand the other party clarify their identity first.
choices.description: Something handed over by a person of unknown origin cannot be easily accepted.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may no longer provide assistance.

dialogue.content: "Sorry, Senior." Chen Ji placed his hands behind his back, not taking the jade slip. "I have never met Senior before and dare not easily accept Senior's kindness. If Senior truly wishes to help, perhaps Senior could clarify matters first."

text.content: The mysterious man was stunned for a moment, then let out a soft sigh. "You are indeed as stubborn as Chen Xuan." His tone carried a trace of nostalgia. "Very well, very well." He tossed the jade slip directly to Chen Ji. "You must take this, because..." His voice suddenly dropped, "Chen Nian's fate rests in your hands." Chen Ji's hand that received the jade slip froze abruptly; his face instantly turned pale. His sister's name, spoken from this stranger's mouth, struck him harder than anything else.

"What did you say?" Chen Ji's voice sharpened abruptly. "How do you know about Chen Nian? Where is she?" He fired off three questions in succession, no longer able to maintain his usual composure. His sister had been missing for years, the deepest wound in his heart and the weakness he had always concealed. Now this mysterious person casually mentioned her name, as if discussing something insignificant. Su Qingyao had never seen Chen Ji so unsettled; her heart startled, she instinctively gripped his hand.

dialogue.content: The mysterious man did not answer. He only turned to face the approaching darkness. "She was taken by the Holy Sect, as a... Heavenly Fate Lock-Key." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "You should know what that means." Chen Ji of course knew. A Heavenly Fate Lock-Key was an ancient forbidden technique, using a specific person's soul as the lock to seal or release some powerful force. And those capable of being Heavenly Fate Lock-Keys must have some special connection to the Heavenly Principles. This was precisely what he had always feared.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He was the heir of the Tianji Record and could not let personal emotions disrupt his judgment. But the matter of his sister caused an unprecedented surge of anger and killing intent within him. He turned to look at Su Qingyao, seeing worry and trust in her eyes; that corner of ice in his heart seemed to melt slightly. "Let's go." He finally said, his voice restored to calm, but the light in his eyes burned more intensely than ever before. "Today's kindness, Chen Ji remembers. If Senior ever has a need, Chen Ji will repay it a hundredfold."

dialogue.content: The mysterious man nodded slightly; in his back view, he seemed to see the shadow of another person. "Chen Xuan said exactly the same words back then." He murmured to himself, his voice so low it was almost inaudible. "I hope you can go further than he did." With that, he formed a complex seal with his hand, and the surrounding barrier of runes suddenly intensified, firmly blocking the pursuers and that terrible pressure outside. "Go, castaway of destiny." These were his final words, and then his figure began to blur, as if merging into the void.

text.content: "Castaway of destiny..." Chen Ji quietly repeated this designation, a complex emotion surging in his heart. His father was called a castaway of destiny because he was abandoned by the Tianji Record. And being called a castaway of destiny—what did that mean for him? The Tianji Record Fragment trembled gently in his Mental Sea, as if responding to his question, yet gave no answer. Chen Ji tightly gripped the jade slip in his hand, his knuckles white from the force. No matter how perilous the road ahead, he would find his sister, uncover the secrets of the Tianji Record, and break this so-called destiny.

Su Qingyao silently walked beside him, asking no questions. She could sense the suppressed emotions radiating from Chen Ji—something she had never seen before, a vulnerability and strength coexisting. Along the way, neither spoke; only their footsteps echoed through the silent wilderness. Until the eastern sky began to lighten, they finally stopped in a secluded mountain valley. Chen Ji found a clean stone to sit on, took out the jade slip, and once again probed his spiritual sense into it. This time, he saw more—the ancient stone door had a line of small characters inscribed: "The fourth page lies hidden here."
